metadata.name: Cataclysm-TLG
metadata.summary: Turn-based post-apocalyptic survival game set in a procedurally generated world

content.value: Cataclysm: The Last Generation is a single-player turn-based post-apocalyptic survival game based on Cataclysm: Dark Days Ahead. Set in a procedurally generated world devastated by alien incursions and the undead, it challenges players to endure amidst societal collapse while foregrounding rich character progression and deep life-simulation mechanics.
Refining core survival systems with an emphasis on plausibility, players must adapt to relentless environmental threats, manage resources, and uncover government conspiracies behind the Cataclysm.

items.value: Procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world featuring zombies, alien horrors, and anomalous threats
Comprehensive character progression with survival skill progression and immersive life simulation
Advanced adaptation systems including military-grade cybernetic bionics and genetic mutations
Survivor faction management to recruit companions and establish fortified communities
Extensive arsenal customization and crafting across scavenging expeditions
Built-in interactive tutorial and fully customizable keyboard controls
